name: Omnix StreamRelay
author: admin@omnixstudio.xyz
description: Multistream relay + optional chat. Image pulls from ghcr.io/mohfarzin/omnix-streamrelay (built from https://github.com/MohFarzin/Omnix-StreamRelay). Primary allocation = dashboard; set RTMP_PORT and SRT_PORT to match your other allocations.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -e
cd /mnt/server || exit 1
mkdir -p data logs

REPO_URL="https://github.com/MohFarzin/Omnix-StreamRelay"
RAW_README="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MohFarzin/Omnix-StreamRelay/master/README.md"

if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL "$RAW_README" -o README-FROM-GITHUB.md 2>/dev/null || true
elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  wget -q -O README-FROM-GITHUB.md "$RAW_README" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

cat > README-OMNIX.txt << EOF
Omnix StreamRelay — install complete
====================================
Source: ${REPO_URL}
Image:  ghcr.io/mohfarzin/omnix-streamrelay:latest
        (Wings pulls this automatically — no manual upload)

1. Set PUBLIC_HOST, RTMP_PORT, SRT_PORT to match allocations.
2. Leave secrets as auto.
3. Start the server.
4. Open http://PUBLIC_HOST:PRIMARY_PORT/ and log in with the
   token from console / FIRST_LOGIN.txt.

OBS main:     rtmp://PUBLIC_HOST:RTMP_PORT/live   key=mystream
OBS vertical: same server                         key=mystream_v
EOF

date -u > .omnix-installed
echo "$REPO_URL" > .omnix-source
sync
echo Install complete
exit 0

variables.name: Public Host
variables.description: DNS or public IP shown in FIRST_LOGIN / OBS URLs.

variables.name: RTMP Port
variables.description: Must match your RTMP allocation (container listens on this port).

variables.name: SRT Port
variables.description: Must match your SRT allocation (UDP preferred).

variables.name: Dashboard Port Override
variables.description: Leave empty to use primary allocation (SERVER_PORT).

variables.name: Bootstrap Token
variables.description: Dashboard login. Use auto to generate on first start.

variables.name: OBS Publish Password
variables.description: Legacy. OBS auth is OFF — leave auto.

variables.name: Ingest Stream Key (main)
variables.description: OBS main stream key (path after /live/).

variables.name: Ingest Stream Key (vertical)
variables.description: Aitum / 9:16 key. Defaults to mystream_v if empty at runtime when unset in older panels.

variables.name: Master Key
variables.description: Encrypts destination keys. Leave auto.

variables.name: JWT Access Secret
variables.description: Internal. Leave auto.

variables.name: JWT Refresh Secret
variables.description: Internal. Leave auto.

variables.name: MediaMTX API Password
variables.description: Internal. Leave auto.

variables.name: OPTIONAL Twitch Channel
variables.description: Leave empty unless you want Twitch chat.

variables.name: OPTIONAL Twitch Token
variables.description: Twitch chat OAuth token. Leave empty if unused.

variables.name: OPTIONAL YouTube Live Chat ID
variables.description: Leave empty if you only need video restream.

variables.name: OPTIONAL YouTube API Key
variables.description: Leave empty if unused.

variables.name: YouTube OAuth Client ID
variables.description: Google Cloud OAuth client ID for YouTube Live manager (dashboard).

variables.name: YouTube OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: Google Cloud OAuth client secret. Required with Client ID for Connect Google.

variables.name: YouTube OAuth Redirect URI
variables.description: Optional full override. Default is http(s)://PUBLIC_HOST:PORT/api/v1/youtube/oauth/callback

variables.name: OPTIONAL Kick Channel
variables.description: Leave empty if unused.

variables.name: OPTIONAL Kick Token
variables.description: Leave empty if unused.
